timezone: mixed: each record carries date_timezone (board dates as stored, WhatsApp Asia/Jerusalem, BigQuery UTC); not converted
rules: no guessed dates: a missing date is null with null_reasons
board test windows are test-population scope, not live-ops for all players
category on board items comes only from the board Type label

board_test_window.definition: A/B test window as recorded on the approved Monday board: start_date = board Start Date column, end_date = board End Date column. Scope is the test population, not all players. A start date on a Backlog/planned item can be a planned date; board_status is carried so readers can tell.

board_type_category.definition: category from the board Type label only: Album->album, OFFER/Offers->sale_offer, Pricing->price_change, Feature Launch->feature_launch; any other or empty Type -> ab_test. No keyword guessing on board items. The Disney board has no Type column, so all Disney board items are ab_test.
board_type_category.source: Monday Type column (Dice status_1__1, Domino color_mm42czg4)

board_date_implemented.definition: Dice board "Date Implemented" column (date_mkq2qsfm) = deploy/implementation date to players -> feature_launch event with start_date = that date, end_date null.
board_date_implemented.question: Is the Dice board "Date Implemented" the date the change went live for all players (so it can be treated as a feature launch date)?

bq_album_season.definition: Album season window from the game dbt album-season model (see source_table); dates UTC as stored.
bq_album_season.question: Can the dbt album-season tables be used as the official album calendar? (Dice is derived from event parameters, Disney from int_album_config.)

whatsapp_launch.definition: WhatsApp message whose extracted decision is "launched": start_date = the message date (Asia/Jerusalem), not a confirmed launch time. end_date null.
whatsapp_launch.question: Can a WhatsApp "launched" message date be used as the start date when the board has none?

whatsapp_deploy.definition: WhatsApp message with an extracted deploy decision (deploy / deployed / deploy (partial) / deploy (with asterisk)). The deploy date is not stated, so start_date is null; announced_on = message date.

whatsapp_keyword_category.definition: category for WhatsApp events from explicit words in the test name or text: album -> album; price/pricing -> price_change; offer/sale/deal/bundle -> sale_offer; otherwise ab_test (launched) or feature_launch (deploy).
whatsapp_keyword_category.question: Is keyword-based categorisation of WhatsApp messages acceptable, or should category come only from the board?
